notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/860ff34de3e505e7c60dd54d59b1fbd230cba3da.jpg[/img]

[h2]The New Screenshots[/h2]
[p]
[b]"I scoured every hallway for answers, but all I found was that twisted grin creeping out of the walls..."[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/a14611d980e819cda2f50b67c2ae40bbbd5376cc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/75344fc25d2b512ddeb69cf3f812d6640ea2e1e8.jpg[/img]
[/p]
[p]
[b]"Each room feels like a trace of madness: the bedroom's blood is still fresh, and the hall is strewn with scattered papers, as if someone drowned in their own obsession."[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/aa8611cc6f5cc034cae3fa1c087e44ff16d7a7bd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/c6e3a04609bf9a327dbb391b41f2c7664ab2bd53.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/0118a46c9bade7349eba1888b06a4fa9d9665474.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/b38ebcdd9beee59e91e3188d3f546f89ec364fac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067836/490df2dfd058cb6366c60a9375294e7cf86a6804.jpg[/img]
[/p]
[h3]So, which part of this madness intrigues you the most? Let us know in the comments what you’d like to see in future updates.[/h3]
